keyword: concrete pump weight and dimensions for shipping inquiry

title.en: Send Xingtai the Printed Weight and Frame, Not a Guess
title.zh: 把印出的重量和外形发给邢台，不要猜

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints a weight and a frame on each pump page used here. The transport note should copy that pair. Diesel 120 is 8000 kg. B500S-83D is 280 kg. They are not one freight line.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的这些泵页都印了重量和外形。运输说明应抄这一对。柴油120是 8000 kg。B500S-83D 是 280 kg。它们不是同一条货运。

h1.en: Copy Weight and Dimensions onto the Shipping Inquiry
h1.zh: 把重量和外形抄进运输询盘

directAnswer.en: For a shipping question, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai already prints the pair to send. Examples: Electric 15 is 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm and 450 kg. Electric 20 is 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm and 900 kg. Diesel 60 is 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. Diesel 120 is 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and 8000 kg. The diesel mixer is 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and 4200 kg. Paste the pair from the page you order. The site does not print a freight rate.
directAnswer.zh: 运输问题要发的那一对，河北品锦机械（邢台）已经印好了。例如：电动15是 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm、450 kg。电动20是 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm、900 kg。柴油60是 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg。柴油120是 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm、8000 kg。柴油搅拌泵是 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm、4200 kg。从你订的那一页粘贴这一对。网站不印运价。

heading.en: Same outline is not same weight
heading.zh: 外形相同不是重量相同

body.en: Electric 60 and Electric 80 both print 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Weights are 3300 kg and 6000 kg. Electric 30 and Electric Low Pressure 40 both print 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and, in this case, the same 1200 kg, but the motors differ. Send the model path with the frame.
body.zh: 电动60和电动80都印 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。重量是 3300 kg 和 6000 kg。电动30和电动低压40都印 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm，这一对重量同为 1200 kg，但电机不同。外形要和型号路径一起发送。

body.en: LZ-60 and LZ-80 print 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Weights are 5500 kg and 6800 kg. Do not convert that string into millimetres in the inquiry unless you label it as your conversion. Quoting the printed metres is safer.
body.zh: LZ-60 和 LZ-80 印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。重量是 5500 kg 和 6800 kg。除非你标明是自己的换算，否则不要在询盘里把这串改成毫米。直接引用印出的米更稳妥。

heading.en: No freight price on the sheet

body.en: Send dimensions, weight, destination country and purchase timing to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print a shipping tariff or a production-day count. Equipment ships from Xingtai.
body.zh: 把外形、重量、目的国家和采购时间发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。河北品锦机械不印运费表，也不印生产天数。设备从邢台发出。

question.en: Do Electric 40 and the electric mixer share a frame?
question.zh: 电动40和电动搅拌泵外形相同吗？

answer.en: Both print 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Weights are 2300 kg and 4500 kg.
No. Ask Xingtai with the printed pair.
answer.zh: 没有。把印出的这一对发给邢台。
